title: Battle of Belmont (1899)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Belmont (1899)", at revision 1370433957, opens: "The Battle of Belmont was an engagement of the Second Boer War on 23 November 1899, where the British under Lord Methuen assaulted a Boer position on Belmont kopje." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q369859, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1899 battle of the Second Boer War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
